_comment: Starting points: indicative average list prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens (in = uncached input, out = output, cache_read and cache_write = prompt caching). They are rounded, not quotes: check each provider's pricing page and edit them in AI Dash (Settings > Model prices) or here. A model that is missing from this file stays unpriced in the dashboard. The model name must match what your usage log records.
